Indexes.Definition: CREATE INDEX idx_accounts_50m_covering ON eap_audit_20261028.accounts_50m USING btree (id) INCLUDE (balance, active)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_accounts_50m_id ON eap_audit_20261028.accounts_50m USING btree (id)

RedundancyAnalysis.Explanation: idx_accounts_50m_id (UNIQUE btree on id) and idx_accounts_50m_covering (btree on id INCLUDE balance, active) are both B-trees with leading key column 'id'. If idx_accounts_50m_covering were declared UNIQUE, idx_accounts_50m_id would be 100% redundant. Even without UNIQUE, any query filtering on 'id' can execute via the covering index. Maintaining both forces PostgreSQL to double-index every insert/update.

UnitDiscrepancyExplanation: The previous report labeled 5.96 MiB as '5.96 MB'. In decimal units (base 10), 6,250,000 bytes is exactly 6.25 MB. In binary units (base 2), 6,250,000 bytes / (1024^2) is 5.960464 MiB. The prior report performed division by 1024*1024 but appended the decimal 'MB' suffix. Similarly, 31,250,000 bytes was reported as '29.8 MB' instead of 31.25 MB decimal / 29.80 MiB binary.
